vikas_veer.title: The Inaugurator
vikas_veer.bio: Has cut the ribbon on every flyover in the district, some of them twice. Leads from the front, usually at a sprint.
vikas_veer.tip: Land the dash right next to someone: the scissors snap shut where you stop.
vikas_veer.quote: Another flyover? Hand me the scissors!

chanakya_rao.title: The Strategist
chanakya_rao.bio: Keeps three plans in his kurta pocket and a fourth in his head. Fights from a distance, and never starts a fight he has not planned.
chanakya_rao.tip: Fire the barrage from close range: the further away, the fewer scrolls hit.

sadak_kumar.title: The Contractor
sadak_kumar.bio: Every road he builds comes with a speed breaker. Some come with nothing else.
sadak_kumar.tip: Run the speed breakers down the road they are chasing you along, then turn and fight.
sadak_kumar.quote: Road closed. Permanently. For your safety.

kila_singh.title: The Fort
kila_singh.bio: Retired from guarding a real fort; now guards the party office with the same lathi and none of the patience.
kila_singh.tip: Drive the bulldozer through a crowd: you take less damage and everyone gets shoved aside.
kila_singh.quote: Nobody enters the office. Not even the peon.

toofan_rani.title: The Storm
toofan_rani.bio: Turned a small protest into a state-wide wave and a megaphone into a weapon. Arrives loud and leaves louder.
toofan_rani.tip: Wait until two enemies are close, then swing the fish: it hits everyone around you.

bijli_babu.title: The Lineman
bijli_babu.bio: Former electricity board clerk who knows exactly where every switch in the city is. Uses that knowledge politically.
bijli_babu.tip: Fire Bijli Giri, then keep shooting: the red circles give them half a second to run, so aim for corners.
bijli_babu.quote: Free bijli for everyone! Except you.

pandit_shabdkosh.title: The Dictionary
pandit_shabdkosh.bio: Has never used a short word where a long one would do. Debates opponents into exhaustion, then closes the argument with the dictionary.
pandit_shabdkosh.tip: Slam the dictionary a step ahead of a chasing enemy; it stuns whoever it lands on.

dharna_dada.title: The Sit-in
dharna_dada.bio: Has sat in protest outside every office in the district. Once sat for so long they moved the office.
dharna_dada.tip: Quake when you're surrounded: it hits everyone and you take 40% less damage for 3 seconds.
